payload.core_composition_summary: The solution performs an exhaustive search over possible subnet masks, checking if the number of distinct masked addresses equals k. Bitwise operations are used for mask construction and application, but the core algorithm is a simple complete search, not a combination of distinct mechanisms.
payload.rationale: The code iterates over all mask lengths (31 down to 1) and evaluates each mask on all IPs. This is a straightforward complete search without additional algorithmic coordination.
